title: Stein's square function associated with the Bochner-Riesz means on Métivier groups and its applications
summary: In this paper, we study the $L^p$-boundedness of Stein's square function $\mathfrak{S}^α(\mathcal{L})$ associated with the sub-Laplacian $\mathcal{L}$ on Métivier group $G$. A key aspect of our result is that the smoothness condition is expressed in terms of the topological dimension $d$ of the underlying Métivier group $G$. Consequently, we also present several applications of the $L^p$-boundedness of $\mathfrak{S}^α(\mathcal{L})$.
